findings.source_quote: Yet, on this momentous winter evening, Feliz Mantz, Conrad Grebel, George Blaurock, and a few others took their obedience one step further.
findings.suggested_fix:
Preserve the printed English spelling "Feliz Mantz" as it appears in the authoritative English source. In the Greek translation, replace "Felix Mantz" with "Feliz Mantz" (preserving surrounding punctuation and HTML structure). Example replacement inside the same

element: "... εκείνη τη μνημειώδη χειμωνιάτικη βραδιά, ο Feliz Mantz, ο Conrad Grebel, ..."

findings.location: (third paragraph) — periodical title left in English
findings.source_quote: ... it is much easier to print a periodical magazine such as The Heartbeat of the Remnant.
findings.suggested_fix:
The authoritative English text names the periodical; the translation should either render a conventional Greek title or present the original title with a clear Greek rendering. Do not leave the quoted substantive title untranslated without indication. Suggested fixes (choose one and apply in-place, preserving tags):
- Translate to Greek: «... είναι πολύ ευκολότερο να τυπώσεις ένα περιοδικό όπως Ο Παλμός των Υπολειμμάτων.»
- Or keep original and add a Greek rendering: «... ένα περιοδικό όπως The Heartbeat of the Remnant (Ο Παλμός των Υπολειμμάτων).»
Keep punctuation and HTML intact.
findings.translation_quote: Αλλά σήμερα είναι πολύ ευκολότερο να τυπώσεις ένα περιοδικό όπως το The Heartbeat of the Remnant.

findings.source_quote: ... the printing press will print 6,000 copies in a little over 12 hours.
